accounts_owner_matches_kind.name: accounts_owner_matches_kind
accounts_owner_matches_kind.value: ("accounts"."kind" in ('client', 'partner') and "accounts"."owner_id" is not null) or ("accounts"."kind" in ('revenue', 'payable', 'settlement') and "accounts"."owner_id" is null)

commission_rules_percent_range.name: commission_rules_percent_range
commission_rules_percent_range.value: "commission_rules"."percent_basis_points" >= 0 and "commission_rules"."percent_basis_points" <= case when "commission_rules"."product" = 'message' then 100000 else 10000 end

limit_rules_period_start_day.name: limit_rules_period_start_day
limit_rules_period_start_day.value: "limit_rules"."period_start_day" is null or ("limit_rules"."window" = 'month' and "limit_rules"."period_start_day" between 1 and 28)

limit_rules_partner_sets_own.name: limit_rules_partner_sets_own
limit_rules_partner_sets_own.value: "limit_rules"."set_by" = 'platform' or "limit_rules"."partner_id" is not null or "limit_rules"."sim_card_id" is not null

limit_rules_single_subject.name: limit_rules_single_subject
limit_rules_single_subject.value: ("limit_rules"."client_id" is not null)::int + ("limit_rules"."channel_id" is not null)::int + ("limit_rules"."partner_id" is not null)::int + ("limit_rules"."sim_card_id" is not null)::int = 1

messenger_accounts_limits_positive.name: messenger_accounts_limits_positive
messenger_accounts_limits_positive.value: ("messenger_accounts"."limit_per_minute" is null or "messenger_accounts"."limit_per_minute" > 0) and ("messenger_accounts"."limit_per_day" is null or "messenger_accounts"."limit_per_day" > 0)

operators_mvno_has_host.name: operators_mvno_has_host
operators_mvno_has_host.value: ("operators"."is_mvno" = false and "operators"."host_operator_id" is null) or ("operators"."is_mvno" = true and "operators"."host_operator_id" is not null)

reservations_settled_at_matches_status.name: reservations_settled_at_matches_status
reservations_settled_at_matches_status.value: ("reservations"."status" = 'held' and "reservations"."settled_at" is null) or ("reservations"."status" <> 'held' and "reservations"."settled_at" is not null)

sip_trunks_registration_needs_credential.name: sip_trunks_registration_needs_credentials
sip_trunks_registration_needs_credential.value: not "sip_trunks"."registers_outbound" or ("sip_trunks"."outbound_username" is not null and "sip_trunks"."outbound_secret" is not null)

users_totp_confirmed_requires_secret.name: users_totp_confirmed_requires_secret
users_totp_confirmed_requires_secret.value: "users"."totp_confirmed_at" is null or "users"."totp_secret" is not null
